item.title: Long day care fee relief: 2027 rates and payment dates explained
item.description: The NSW Department of Education’s 2027 Fee Relief for Long Day Care guidelines set out the annual funding rates, payment dates and participation requirements for eligible services. The program will replace Start Strong for Long Day Care from 1 January 2027, with annual fee relief of up to $2,625 per eligible child.

item.title: Family day care educator earns national recognition after 15 years
item.description: CCA Family Day Care educator Tivana Sando has been named one of four national Educator of the Year finalists in the 2026 Excellence in Family Day Care Awards. The Sydney educator will represent the combined NSW/ACT region when the national winners are announced in Brisbane on 28 November.

item.title: On Country early learning program earns national recognition
item.description: Indi Kindi’s Walking Learning curriculum has won Gold at the 2026 Australian Good Design Awards, adding to national recognition for the remote Northern Territory early education program. Moriarty Foundation’s Indi Kindi has also been named a Human Rights Medal finalist in the 2026 Australian Human Rights Awards.
